P1.falsifier: In a sample of >= 20 such galaxies at 3 <= z <= 12 with resolved kinematics and baryonic masses that include measured gas, the median log10(M_dyn/M_bar) at matched g_bar differs from P1 by more than 0.2 dex beyond the quoted systematic error, or the dark fraction at fixed g_bar decreases with redshift between z = 3 and z = 10.
P1.name: Dynamical-to-baryonic mass of relaxed galaxies at redshift z
P1.statement: For a galaxy whose condensed baryons (stars and cold gas) dominate its baryonic field and whose stock has relaxed (age >~ 100 Myr after its main progenitor crossed the release gate), the enclosed dynamical mass within radius r obeys M_dyn(<r) / M_bar(<r) = nu(g_bar(r)/a0(z)), nu(y) = 1/(1 - exp(-sqrt y)), g_bar = G M_bar(<r)/r^2 (spherical; disks carry geometry corrections of the paper), a0(z) = 1.2501e-10 m s^-2 x E(z), E(z) = sqrt(0.3035 (1+z)^3 + 0.6965).
P1.status_against_existing_data: z ~ 5.5-7.4 (de Graaff et al. 2024, 6 galaxies): mean offset -0.11 dex, rms 0.24 dex, tied with an abundance-matched NFW model (+0.12, 0.24) and better than constant a0 (+0.24, 0.33). z ~ 0.6-2.5 (RC100, Nestor Shachar et al. 2023, medians): at the sample median Sigma_bar the law predicts f_DM(R_e) = 0.34 at z ~ 1 (observed 0.38) and 0.45 at z ~ 2 (observed 0.27 +- 0.02); the tension at z ~ 2 depends on the baryonic surface density of that bin and on the gas-mass and pressure-support systematics, and is recorded here as an existing tension, not a prediction.

P2.falsifier: A projected mass inside 20 kpc at or above the matched NFW value with a total uncertainty below 15 %.
P2.name: XLSSC 122 inner core (z = 1.98)
P2.statement: With spectroscopic arc redshifts and a free inner mass profile, the projected mass inside 20 kpc of the BCG is 20-35 % below that of an NFW model matched to the projected mass at 100 kpc (support radius 14-51 kpc for f_gas = 0.05-0.15); the projected mass at R >= 50 kpc equals the CDM model.

P3.name: Halo abundance relative to LambdaCDM on the same likelihood
P3.statement: n(>M) at z = 1.98 is 1.22 (M = 1.6e14) and 1.28 (2.6e14) times LambdaCDM; at z = 14.44 it is 1.18 (1e10) and 1.24 (3e10) times.

not_predicted: The UV luminosity function at z = 9-14.5 does not separate the theories: with one feedback-regulated model calibrated separately for each theory at z = 4, the predicted log phi differ by <= 0.03 dex at z = 9-14.5, because the deeper central wells of the relaxed stock are already present at z = 4 and enter the calibration.
